Split Violin Plot Type

Source: R/type_split_violin.R
type_split_violin.Rd

Creates publication-ready split violin plots comparing two conditions (such as Healthy vs Diseased, Control vs Treatment, or Responder vs Non-Responder) side-by-side as left and right halves sharing a common categorical axis.

Usage

type_split_violin(
  inner = c("quartiles", "boxplot", "mean_se", "none"),
  quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
  quantile_color = "grey25",
  quantile_linewidth = 0.45,
  quantile_linetype = "solid",
  add_jitter = FALSE,
  jitter_width = 0.08,
  jitter_alpha = 0.45,
  jitter_size = 1.3,
  violin_alpha = 0.8,
  violin_color = "#20242A",
  linewidth = 0.35,
  box_width = 0.15,
  box_fill = c("group", "white"),
  box_alpha = 0.9,
  trim = TRUE,
  scale = "width",
  orientation = c("vertical", "horizontal")
)

Arguments

inner

Interior summary structure: "quartiles" (default, draws 25%, median, and 75% quantile lines), "boxplot" (miniature boxplot on each half), "mean_se" (mean diamond glyph with standard error bar), or "none".

quantiles

Numeric vector of quantile probabilities (default c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)).

quantile_color

Color for quantile lines (default "grey25").

quantile_linewidth

Line width for quantile lines (default 0.45).

quantile_linetype

Line type for quantile lines (default "solid").

add_jitter

Add jittered points on each split half (default FALSE).

jitter_width

Horizontal jitter width (default 0.08).

jitter_alpha

Point transparency (default 0.45).

jitter_size

Point size (default 1.3).

violin_alpha

Transparency of split violins (default 0.8).

violin_color

Border color of violins (default "#20242A").

linewidth

Outline stroke width (default 0.35).

box_width

Width of inner boxplot when inner = "boxplot" (default 0.15).

box_fill

Fill style for inner boxplot: "group" (default, filled by group color) or "white".

box_alpha

Transparency of inner boxplot (default 0.9).

trim

Trim violin tails to observed data range (default TRUE).

scale

Violin scaling method: "width" (default, all categories have equal maximum width), "area", or "count".

orientation

Plot orientation: "vertical" (default) or "horizontal".

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Compare supplement effects across doses
cliplot(len ~ dose | supp, data = ToothGrowth,
        type = type_split_violin(),
        title = "Odontoblast Length by Dose & Supplement")

# With inner boxplots highlighted by group
cliplot(len ~ dose | supp, data = ToothGrowth,
        type = type_split_violin(inner = "boxplot"))
} # }
